name: Sengoku Hime 3 ~Tenka o Kirisaku Hikari to Kage~
original_name: 戦極姫3～天下を切り裂く光と影～
source:
The third installment of the Sengoku SLG series, with even more female commanders at your disposal. You can actually have them all under your command via the "persuasion event". Obviously, the goal is to unite the country by defeating all those get in your way.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/06/01/june-2011-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
战国SLG系列的第三部，供你调遣的女性武将数量进一步增加。
通过“劝降事件”，你甚至能让她们悉数归入麾下。
目标自然是击败一切挡路之人，统一天下。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/06/01/june-2011-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
